title: 第一卷 第9章 贼人落网！
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓

第(1/3)页

林骁深夜敲门，院里很快传来脚步声。

“谁在外面？”一道温婉的声音响起。

“晚晴，是我。”林骁回应。

杨晚晴仔细聆听，确定是林骁后，松了口气，快步上前开门。

开门后，杨晚晴提着油灯，昏黄的光映着她丰腴的身形。

她穿着厚棉衣，但依然掩不住婀娜曲线。

在饥荒年里，林骁不时接济，让她比其他村妇多了几分水润。

“林伯？”她眼睛一亮，“这么晚，您怎么来了？”

林骁递过肉：“打了头野猪，这块你留着。”

杨晚晴看着那块肥瘦相间的肉，连连摆手：“不可不可，您上次给的粟米还没吃完呢，这肉您拿回去……”

“拿着。”林骁塞进她手里，“家里还有，冬天冷，多吃点肉才扛得住。”

杨晚晴眼圈一红，接过肉，声音哽咽：“谢林伯……大恩大德，真不知如何报答……”

“好好活着，就是报答。”林骁笑道。

这时，脑中忽然响起系统提示：

【叮，检测到可绑定优质伴侣：杨晚晴，28岁】

【命格：双绝，对不怀好意之男子有克制之效，对心存善意之男子有旺夫之能】

【是否绑定？】

林骁心里咯噔一下。

【倒计时：3、2、1——】

【绑定成功，当前初始亲密值：60】

提示音消失，周围恢复正常。

“林伯？”杨晚晴见他发愣，轻声问，“您怎么了？”

“没、没什么。”林骁回过神。

“进屋喝杯热茶吧？”杨晚晴侧身让开。

林骁犹豫一下，点头进了院子。

屋里炉火烧得正旺，暖和。

杨晚晴去倒茶，走路时微微跛脚。

“你的腿怎么了？”林骁关心问道。

“前两日扫雪，不小心摔了一跤。”杨晚晴不好意思道，“不碍事的。”

“什么不碍事。”林骁皱眉，“脱下鞋袜我看看，万一伤到骨头就麻烦了。”

杨晚晴脸一红。

女子的脚何等私密……

“我是你林伯，还见外？”林骁催促。

杨晚晴这才坐下，慢慢脱了鞋袜。

一只白皙的脚露出来，脚踝处肿得发亮，皮肤下泛着青紫。

林骁蹲下身，手指轻轻按了按伤处。

杨晚晴疼得吸气。

“骨头错位了。”林骁沉声道，“忍着点疼。”

他握住她脚踝，猛地一扭一推。

“啊！”

杨晚晴痛呼一声，随即觉得那股钻心的疼减轻了。

“走走看。”

杨晚晴穿好鞋袜，起身走了几步，惊喜道：“真不疼了！林伯，您还会这个？”

“小事。”林骁接过茶喝了，起身要走。

“林伯等一下。”杨晚晴从里屋提出一小篮鸡蛋，“这个您带回去。”

“你留着自己吃。”

“还有不少呢。”杨晚晴塞进他手里，“您拿着。”

林骁不再推辞，接过篮子：“行，那我走了，记得好好养着，少走动。”

“哎。”

离开杨家，林骁往家的方向走。

路上，林骁不由得叹息一声，系统给自己绑定的对象倒是优质，只是年龄差距太大，让人家如何接受呢？

不过，在这乱世荒年，很多事情都有可能。

很快，林骁返回院子，将鸡蛋放入灶间。

上官飞燕正蹲着，吭哧吭哧清理猪皮。

见林骁回来，她扶着腰站起来，一脸苦相：“累死我了……不过马上好了！”

林骁笑道：“辛苦了，明天奖励你多吃一碗饭。”

“真的？”上官飞燕眼睛一亮，干得更起劲了。

猪皮清理干净，林骁开始熬猪皮冻。

猪皮下锅，加水，慢火熬煮。

这一熬就是三个时辰。

上官飞燕负责烧火，哈欠连天：“这也太费柴了……”

“柴多的是，不碍事。”林骁看着锅里渐渐浓稠的胶质。

熬好时，已近深夜。

上官飞燕困得眼皮打架，林骁摆手：“去睡吧。”

“终于完了……”上官飞燕摇摇晃晃起身。

“等等，”林骁叫住她，“去给我暖床。”

“又暖？”上官飞燕哀叹，但还是磨磨蹭蹭往偏房走。

这时苏馨月从正屋出来：“林伯，我和清雪病都好多了，今晚您睡正屋吧，我睡偏房。”

“不用，”林骁摆了摆手，“你们三个睡正屋就好。”

Page (1/3)

Lin Xiao knocked on the door late at night, and footsteps soon came from the courtyard.

"Who's outside?" A gentle voice sounded.

"Wanqing, it's me." Lin Xiao responded.

Yang Wanqing listened carefully and after confirming that it was Lin Xiao, she breathed a sigh of relief and quickly stepped forward to open the door.

After opening the door, Yang Wanqing held an oil lamp, and the dim light reflected her plump figure.

She was wearing thick cotton clothes, but she still couldn't hide her graceful curves.

During the famine years, Lin Xiao continued to help her, making her a little more hydrated than other village women.

"Lin Bo?" Her eyes lit up, "Why are you here so late?"

Lin Xiao handed over the meat: "I killed a wild boar, you can keep this piece."

Yang Wanqing looked at the piece of fat and thin meat and waved her hands repeatedly: "No, no, no, I haven't finished the corn you gave me last time. You can take this meat back..."

"Take it." Lin Xiao stuffed it into her hand, "I still have it at home. It's cold in the winter, so I need to eat more meat to bear it."

Yang Wanqing's eyes turned red, and she took the meat, her voice choked with sobs: "Thank you, Uncle Lin... for being such a kindness, I really don't know how to repay..."

"Living well is repayment." Lin Xiao said with a smile.

At this time, a system prompt suddenly sounded in my mind:

[Ding, it has been detected that a high-quality partner can be bound: Yang Wanqing, 28 years old]

[Destiny: Double Absolute, has the effect of restraining men with ill intentions, and has the ability to prosper men with good intentions]

【Bind?】

Lin Xiao's heart skipped a beat.

[Countdown: 3, 2, 1——]

[Binding successful, current initial intimacy value: 60]

The beep disappears and the surroundings return to normal.

"Uncle Lin?" Seeing him in a daze, Yang Wanqing asked softly, "What's wrong with you?"

"No, it's nothing." Lin Xiao came back to his senses.

"Come in and have a cup of hot tea?" Yang Wanqing stepped aside.

Lin Xiao hesitated, nodded and entered the yard.

The fire in the room was burning brightly and warm.

Yang Wanqing went to pour tea and walked with a slight limp.

"What's wrong with your legs?" Lin Xiao asked with concern.

"I accidentally fell while sweeping snow two days ago." Yang Wanqing said sheepishly, "It's okay."

"It's okay." Lin Xiao frowned, "Take off your shoes and socks and let me take a look. If you hurt a bone, you'll be in trouble."

Yang Wanqing blushed.

A woman's feet are so private...

"I'm your Uncle Lin, why don't you meet me outside?" Lin Xiao urged.

Yang Wanqing then sat down and slowly took off her shoes and socks.

A white foot was exposed, the ankle was swollen and shiny, and there were bruises under the skin.

Lin Xiao knelt down and gently pressed the injured area with his fingers.

Yang Wanqing inhaled in pain.

"The bones are dislocated." Lin Xiao said solemnly, "endure the pain."

He held her ankle and twisted and pushed her hard.

"Ah!"

Yang Wanqing cried out in pain, and then she felt that the heart-wrenching pain eased.

"Let's take a look."

Yang Wanqing put on her shoes and socks, stood up and walked a few steps. She was pleasantly surprised and said, "It doesn't hurt anymore! Uncle Lin, can you still do this?"

"It's a small matter." Lin Xiao took the tea and drank it, then stood up to leave.

"Uncle Lin, wait a moment." Yang Wanqing took out a small basket of eggs from the back room, "Take this back."

"You keep it for yourself."

"There are quite a few more." Yang Wanqing stuffed it into his hand, "Take it."

Lin Xiao stopped refusing and took the basket: "Okay, I'll go then. Remember to take good care of it and move around less."

"Hey."

After leaving Yang's house, Lin Xiao walked towards home.

On the way, Lin Xiao couldn't help but sigh. The person the system bound to him was of high quality, but the age gap was too big. How could he accept it?

However, in these troubled times, many things are possible.

Soon, Lin Xiao returned to the yard and put the eggs in the stove.

Shangguan Feiyan was squatting down, cleaning the pig skin with squeaking sounds.

Seeing Lin Xiao coming back, she stood up holding her waist with a grimace on her face: "I'm exhausted... but I'll be fine soon!"

Lin Xiao smiled and said: "Thank you for your hard work, I will reward you with an extra bowl of rice tomorrow."

"Really?" Shangguan Feiyan's eyes lit up and she worked even harder.

After cleaning the pig skin, Lin Xiao started making pig skin jelly.

Put the pork skin into the pot, add water and simmer over low heat.

This lasted for three hours.

Shangguan Feiyan was in charge of lighting the fire and yawned profusely: "This wastes too much firewood..."

"There's plenty of firewood, so it won't be a problem." Lin Xiao looked at the gelatin that was gradually thickening in the pot.

By the time I finished it, it was almost late at night.

Shangguan Feiyan's eyelids were so sleepy that they twitched. Lin Xiao waved his hand: "Go to sleep."

"It's finally over..." Shangguan Feiyan stood up unsteadily.

"Wait," Lin Xiao stopped her, "go warm my bed."

"It's too warm?" Shangguan Feiyan lamented, but still walked to the side room slowly.

At this time, Su Xinyue came out of the main room: "Uncle Lin, Qingxue and I are much better. You can sleep in the main room tonight, and I will sleep in the side room."

"No need," Lin Xiao waved his hand, "You three can just sleep in the main room."
